text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower lacked confidence in herself, 
but now, a long-awaited Trainer had 
finally arrived at her side.

Taking this opportunity, Rice Shower 
resolves to grow from a "bad girl" who 
brings misfortune into a "blue rose" who 
can bring happiness to others.

However, due to a string of "misfortunes," 
Rice Shower ends up arriving extremely 
late for her first day of training.

"As she tries to make up for lost time on 
her own, her Trainer extends a hand, 
offering to work hard together as a team."
